name: @supacloud/app
description: Angular-style application metadata for SupaCloud: modules, DI tokens, providers, scopes, controllers and commands

scripts.build: bun run clean && bun run build:js && bun run build:types
scripts.build:js: bun build src/index.ts src/execution.ts --outdir dist --target node --format esm --external @supacloud/contracts && bun build src/contract_client.ts src/browser.ts --outdir dist --target browser --format esm --external @supacloud/contracts

bun build src/index.ts src/execution.ts --outdir dist --target node --external @supacloud/contracts --external '@angular/*' --external rxjs && bun build src/index.ts --outfile dist/index.cjs --target node --format cjs --external '@angular/*' --external rxjs && bun build src/contract_client.ts src/browser.ts --outdir dist --target browser --external @supacloud/contracts && bun build src/reactive.ts --outdir dist --target browser --external rxjs && bun build src/angular.ts src/rxjs.ts --outdir dist --target browser --external '@angular/*' --external rxjs && bun build src/http.ts --outdir dist --target node --external @supacloud/app && bun build src/runtime.ts --outdir dist --target browser
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run build && bun run check:package
